dialogue_history.speaker: grok-3_mas_rag
dialogue_history.sentences_no_utterance_types: Without government oversight, unchecked competition often leads to exploitation and inequality, not progress. Relying on a mixed system risks widening inequality, with only the wealthy getting cutting-edge care while the rest of us are left with underfunded public services. Innovation driven by private players in a mixed system too often ignores the real health crises facing poorer areas, which is why I reckon government intervention is the only way to ensure fair progress. Relying on private healthcare risks creating a society where access to life-saving treatment depends on your bank balance, not your need. Private investment often diverts resources away from public funding, leaving the NHS underfunded and unable to deliver equitable medical advancements for all.
